# Weld Neck Flanges
> Reference site for weld neck flanges: how they work, where they're used, and how to spec them.

## About
Weld Neck Flanges (weldneckflanges.com) is an informational resource on weld neck flanges used in piping systems, pressure vessels and industrial service.

## Topics
- Weld neck flanges per ASME B16.5 (NPS 1/2 to 24) and ASME B16.47 (NPS 26 to 60)
- Long weld neck (nozzle) flanges
- Facings: raised face (RF) and ring type joint (RTJ)
- Materials: carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steel

## Standards
ASME B16.5, ASME B16.47, API 6A, ASTM material specifications
